status: Prospective seventh comparator; not adopted, source-qualified, executable or launched. Original shared-gradient v1 unchanged.
reference: B=(theta_old,phi_plus) after the same native private proposal at the current arm state.
native_proposal: d0 is the actual native shared displacement, with original native own-CE gradient moment/step/buffer transition retained.
parameter_scope: All trainable shared parameters of the same root-pinned ensemble, including shared head if present; private proposal/rule native.
protected_losses: Every member L_m is ordinary full uniform native TRAIN own CE with exact source masks/normalization and coupled shared derivative. No competence selection, graph weights or past-task replay.
gradients: k_m=grad_theta L_m(B), m=1,...,4; a=grad_theta L_pool(B), mean raw logits followed by softmax/CE.
matched_eligibility: Same nonnull pooled gradient and negative native pooled directional progress requirement; same prebound null/rank/KKT/feasibility qualification and native fallback. Every member is offered as a CE constraint, including poor members.
nonidentical_eligibility: Graph arm may have absent constraints/no-support fallback from competence weights. All-member CE arm has no identical competence-support criterion; null CE gradients/ranks handled by same numerical contract.
native_state_and_RNG: Same one native proposal/forward RNG advance, bound dropout-off diagnostic buffer map, original native moments/step/buffer transition, trial discard and native fallback. Numeric private updates are native at each divergent arm state.

finite_guards.evaluation: Same bound dropout-off served-prediction map and frozen B state/private proposal.

guard_differences.different: Per-member CE guard replaces graph arm per-frozen-weighted-margin S_m(corrected)>=S_m(B) guard.
guard_differences.redundancy: Finite mean-own guard is redundant under exact four per-member CE guards; retain explicitly with prebound numerical tolerances.
guard_differences.units: CE nats versus weighted logit margins; prospectively bind appropriate tolerances. Do not claim equal scalar tolerances or an orientation-only comparison.

fallback: Native joint proposal for numerical/infeasible/cap/finite failure; no ridge, cap expansion, alternative block, multiplier search or successful-attempt selection.
construction_diagnostics: Retain all 32 attempted steps/all paired seeds, CE/pooled/mean-own values and deltas, native/corrected displacement norms, ranks/KKT/residuals, eligibility and exact fallback reason; source-bind tolerances before outcomes.
comparison_purpose: Distinguish graph-conditioned response selection from generic simultaneous ordinary member-loss preservation. Label GEM-type member-task control; no standard continual-memory GEM reproduction required.
confirmation: One unused complete compatible graph, Computers only if root-admissible; fresh seeds 109/113/127; freeze all definitions before one heldout opening.
